t: You are on Charlotte Street, which has been described as the spine of Fitzrovia, in central London. It takes its name from Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz, wife of George III and Britain's longest-serving queen consort, at 57 years. Several notable people died on this street. The painter John Constable, famous for his landscapes of Dedham Vale, died here. So did the cleric and naturalist William Bingley, and Henry Scott, the fourth Earl of Deloraine. Constable once wrote that painting is but another word for feeling.
